items.title: Trump urges Nvidia board to rehire Jensen Huang
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. President Donald Trump on Monday renewed his call for Nvidia's (NASDAQ:NVDA) board to reinstate former Chief Executive Jensen Huang, saying his return would benefit both the chipmaker and the United States.

items.title: Asia stocks slide as AI rout deepens despite rebound in U.S. futures
items.summary: Investing.com -- Asian stocks fell on Monday as renewed selling in technology and semiconductor shares deepened concerns over AI valuations and the mounting debt used to finance data-centre investments, even as U.S. equity futures rebounded following Wall Street's sharp weekly losses.
